title: UKPNP High Level Delegation Briefs British MPs on Kashmir Crisis and Current Situation in London House of Parliament
excerpt: A high level UKPNP delegation led by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri briefed British MPs in the House of Parliament on the Kashmir crisis, historical context, and current developments.
author: Special Correspondent, London UK

heroImage.caption: UKPNP delegation briefing British MPs at the House of Parliament.

body.text: A high level delegation of the United Kashmir People’s National Party, led by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri, met and briefed British Parliament Members Fabian Hamilton MP, Richard Burgon MP, Imran Hussain MP, and others at the House of Parliament in London.

The UKPNP delegation headed by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri included Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan, Central Spokesperson UKPNP, Mahmood Kashmiri, Senior Leader UKPNP and Chairman JKNIA, Sardar Tariq Khan, President UK Chapter, and Sardar Tikka Khan Tahir, Central Secretary Information. The delegation briefed MPs on the current situation in Jammu and Kashmir.
